factors.value_notes: A Yucatán PSAT study of 18 fish found experienced temperatures of 10.0–33.6 °C, with most time above 24 °C and apparent use around 24–30 °C; a western North Atlantic PSAT study of 28 fish found greatest time around 26 °C. This closely supports the 23–28 °C ideal, but regional and life-stage caveats remain and the exact 20–30 °C outer range is not calibrated for South Florida.
